description: ImageSTEAM is a freely available computer-vision professional-development and curriculum programme in which teachers learn and implement no-code, browser-based computer-vision lessons using tools such as Teachable Machine, Pixlr, GauGAN, and Tinkercad.
title: ImageSTEAM

description: Imagine Español is Imagine Learning's personalized Spanish language and literacy curriculum for students in grades Pre-K–6, supporting dual-language, transitional bilingual, and world-language programs.
title: Imagine Español

description: Imagine IM is a print and digital K–12 core mathematics curriculum developed by Imagine Learning and certified by Illustrative Mathematics for problem-based, student-centered instruction.
title: Imagine IM

description: Imagine Language & Literacy is Imagine Learning’s web-based adaptive supplemental literacy program for students from pre-kindergarten through sixth grade.
title: Imagine Language & Literacy

description: Imagine Math is Imagine Learning's adaptive digital supplemental mathematics learning platform for Pre-Kindergarten through Geometry, offering scaffolded instruction and on-demand support from certified teachers.
title: Imagine Math

description: Imagine Learning's Imagine Math Facts is a digital 3D game-based program for practicing addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to build arithmetic fluency and automaticity.
title: Imagine Math Facts

description: IMAIOS.com is a paid medical eLearning website operated by IMAIOS that provides dynamic, interactive anatomical images for learning and identifying sectional anatomy structures.
title: IMAIOS.com eLearning website

description: ITEM is a 40-item multidomain self-report questionnaire developed by its original authors to evaluate learner experience in immersive technology-enhanced learning environments across immersion, motivation and educational value, workload, usability, and reflective learning.
title: Immersive Technology Evaluation Measure (ITEM)

description: IMPDET is an international online doctoral study programme in educational technology hosted in Finland and run for doctoral students, particularly from emerging and transitional countries.
title: IMPDET (International Multidisciplinary PhD Studies in Educational Technology)

description: The ITEIS is a 12-item Likert-type self-report scale adapted by Costa and Faria for Portuguese secondary school students to measure entity and incremental beliefs about emotional-intelligence malleability.
title: Implicit Theories of Emotional Intelligence Scale (ITEIS)

description: Chen's framework guides learning-science researchers, designers, educators, and practitioners through six interconnected action areas for infrastructuring and sustaining educational innovations while building practitioner-led design capacity.
title: IMPROV framework

description: A pair of student and teacher surveys administered by the Consortium on Chicago School Research to measure views of school environment, classroom learning, parent involvement, school governance, and teachers' professional work life.
title: Improving Chicago Schools: The Students Speak, 1997 and Improving Chicago Schools: The Teachers' Turn, 1997

description: A biannual Consortium on Chicago School Research survey that collects students' reports on school experiences and educators' reports on instruction and working conditions across Chicago Public Schools.
title: Improving Chicago's Schools biannual survey

description: A Calderdale Excellence Partnership intervention for Year 6 pupils that combines memorable experiences with Self-Regulated Strategy Development writing instruction and associated teacher professional development.
title: Improving Writing Quality intervention delivered by the Calderdale Excellence Partnership

description: IMR-SS is a HoloLens-based immersive mixed-reality training system developed by Qian He et al.
title: IMR-SS
